description:
Holly Herndon's second album Platform proposes new fantasies and rejuvenates old optimism.

Herndon has become a leading light in contemporary music by experimenting within the outer reaches of dance music and pop songwriting possibilities. A galvanising statement, Platform signals Herndon's transformation as an electronic musician to a singular voice.
